claims: Kara Lawson is the head coach of the Duke University women's basketball team.
Kara Lawson has held the position of head coach of the Duke University women's basketball team since July 11, 2020.
Under Kara Lawson's leadership, the Blue Devils have reached the Elite Eight in 2025.
Kara Lawson is a former WNBA champion.
Kara Lawson is a former Olympic gold medalist.
Kara Lawson is a former Boston Celtics assistant coach.
